Maya: FYI preview invoice previews for some tenants show missing route tags after the recent preview-only rekey. Not wide but noticeable.
Ravi: which deploy?
Maya: preview-rekey-v1 -> canary group C, started 2026-03-23T09:05Z. example preview event: `{"tenant":"beta-co","route_id":null,"tokens":42}`
Jules: logs show enrichment join failed for those partition ids. looks like partition key switch broke the shadow fanout mapping.
ingest-bot: consumer-ingest-2 detected partition key change at 09:06Z
Maya: can we replay enrichment for the affected window quickly?
Ravi: yes but beware double-counting in preview. we'll run idempotent replay and validate counts.
Jules: plan: pause canary, replay preview-shadow for shards 112-115, run sanity query comparing preview vs invoice route_id counts, then resume.
Maya: doing pause now.
deploy-bot: canary group C paused for preview-rekey-v1 at 09:12Z
Jules: kickstarting replay: `./shadow_replay --topic=preview-shadow --shards=112-115 --from=2026-03-23T08:50Z`
ingest-bot: replay job 4422 started, ETA 2m
Jules: replay finished. validation: `SELECT count(*) FROM previews WHERE route_id IS NULL AND ts > now() - interval '30 minutes'` -> 1 (was 84)
Maya: OK looks healed. Followups: add rollout blocker if partitioning key changes without `shadow-compat=true`, add e2e that verifies route attr across shadow fanout. filing ticket assigned to Ravi/Jules.
Ravi: agreed. also add console alert when preview/invoice route mismatch > 0.3% for 5m.
Maya: thanks all, marking canary paused and filing ticket. :white_check_mark:
